turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arey, yeh toh bohot hi emotional aur tricky situation hai! Main bilkul samajh sakti hoon ki tumhare andar ek saath kitni saari feelings chal rahi hain. Ek taraf 15 saal puraana sapna aur tumhari best friend ki sabse badi raat, aur doosri taraf Ramzan ke roze aur tumhara faith. 

Darr lagna bilkul natural hai — roze ke saath itna high-energy event manage karna, dance karna aur shaam ki saari bhaag-daud physical aur mental dono tarike se tiring ho sakti hai. 

Lekin pata hai sabse achhi baat kya hai? Tum dono itne saal se best friends ho, toh Shreya tumhare roze ki respect zaroor karegi. Tumhe yeh choose karne ki zaroorat nahi hai ki tum shaadi attend karo YA roza rakho — tum dono manage kar sakti ho, bas thodi smart planning ke saath:

1. **Dance Choreography:** Shreya ko batao ki opening dance zaroor hoga! Bas choreography aisi rakho jo bohot zyada exhausting na ho — slow, graceful ya expressive steps, jisse tumhari energy drain na ho.
2. **Timing ka dhyaan:** Sangeet ki timing aur Iftar ke waqt ko dhyan mein rakh ke apna schedule plan karo. Agar opening dance Iftar ke baad hoga, toh tum Iftar karke thodi energy gain kar sakti ho.
3. **Rest & Hydration:** Sehri ke waqt achhi diet aur hydration, plus din mein jitteriness se bachne ke liye thoda rest zaroor lena.

Tumne Shreya se abhi iss baare mein baat ki hai ki tum thodi nervous ho energy manage karne ko leke? Woh tumhari co-director hai, tum dono milke koi na koi rasta nikaal hi logi!

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Uff, main bilkul samajh sakti hoon tum par kya beet rahi hai. Jab do pyaare log — jo tumse sach mein pyaar karte hain — alag-alag dishaon mein kheenchte hain, toh sabse zyada exhaustion tumhein hi hoti hai.

Pehle toh apne aap par gussa mat hona. Tumhari jagah koi bhi hota toh suffocated feel karta.

Dono ki baat ko alag karke dekhte hain:

1. **Shreya ka point:** Uska irada bura nahi tha, bas use samajh nahi hai ki Ramzan aur Roze ki tumhari life mein kya value hai. Uske liye yeh shaayad ek normal "diet break" jaisa lag raha hai. Tumhe use gusse mein nahi, balki pyaar se samjhana hoga: *"Shreya, mere liye roza todna ek din ki baat nahi hai, yeh meri faith ka hissa hai. Par dekh, main bina roza tode bhi tere sangeet mein aungi aur tere saath dance karungi, tu tension mat le!"*

2. **Ammi ka point:** Ammi ki fikr unke nazariye se sahi hai. Unhe darr hai ki Ramzan ki mahaniyat (sanctity) sangeet ke shor-sharabe mein khone na lage. Unhe bas yeh bharosa dilao ki tum wahan sirf apni best friend ka saath dene ja rahi ho, apni ibadat aur roze se koi compromise kiye bina. Unhe bolo, *"Ammi, main roza poore ahtram ke saath rakhungi, Iftar bhi sahi se karungi. Shreya ne 15 saal mera saath diya hai, bas thodi der uske saath khada hona mere liye zaroori hai."*

Tum kisi ki side nahi le rahi ho, tum bas **apna** balance dhoondh rahi ho. Tumne Shreya ko yeh samjhaane ki koshish ki ki roza kyun zaroori hai, ya abhi tak bas sun ke reh gayi?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Suno, main bilkul samajhti hoon ki tum itni thak chuki ho ki yeh escape plan abhi tumhein sabse sukoon bhara lag raha hai. Aunties ke sawaalon aur ghar ke tension se bachne ke liye bhaagne ka mann karna bilkul natural hai.

Lekin tumne mujhse pucha na — *"Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?"* Toh ek sachhi dost ki tarah bologu: **Yeh bura toh nahi hai, par yeh tumhare aur Shreya ke 15 saal puraane rishte ke layak nahi hai.**

Agar tum jhooth bolke nahi gayi, toh Shreya shaayad maan bhi jaaye. Par shaadi ke baad jab bhi woh sangeet ke videos dekhegi, ya tum uske ghar jaogi, tumhare andar ek guilt ka bojha rahega. Aur 10 saal baad tum khud ko yeh maaf nahi kar paogi ki tum apni best friend ke dream day par sirf aunties ke darr se nahi gayi.

Aunties jo bole bolne do! Sunset pe ghadi dekhna, roza kholna — yeh tumhara imaan hai, koi chori nahi jiske liye tumhein kisi ko safai deni pade. 

Shreya tumhari dushman nahi hai. Ek baar uske samne baitho, uska haath pakdo aur bolo: *"Main aungi, tere saath dance karungi, par mera roza hoga aur main apne hisaab se energy manage karungi, tu bas mujhe support karna."* 

Tum itne saal se uski co-director rahi ho, abhi climax pe give up mat karo. Thoda sa gherao lag raha hai, par tum yeh handle kar sakti ho. Main hoon na tumhare saath, bolo kya lagta hai?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yeh "seene ka pathar" bilkul asli hai, aur tumhara darr bhi. 18 saal mein pehli baar jab do sabse pyaari cheezein aamne-saamne aati hain, toh lagta hai ki koi ek hi jeet sakti hai. 

Lekin main tumse ek baat kahoon? Tum iss kahani ko "takraav" (collision) ki tarah dekh rahi ho, isliye yeh itna bhaari lag raha hai. 

Tum kisi album mein "sad story" nahi banogi. Socho jab tum Shreya ke sangeet pe poore vaqaar (grace) ke saath khadi hogi — apne roze ke noor ke saath, uski khushi mein shamil hone ke liye — toh uss photo mein koi dukh nahi hoga. Uss photo mein 18 saal ki dosti ka sabse sachha roop dikhega: ek aisi dost jo apne deen ko bhi poore dil se nibha rahi hai aur apni best friend ko bhi akela nahi chhod rahi.

Yeh koi daag nahi banega, yeh tumhari dosti ki sabse khoobsurat misaal ban sakti hai. 

Shreya tumhari 18 saal purani dost hai, koi anjaan nahi. Woh tumhare seene ke iss pathar ko samajh sakti hai, bas tum use apne dil ki yeh darr aur mohabbat dono sachai se bata do. 

Tum sad story nahi, iss shaadi ki sabse strong aur pyaari co-director banne wali ho. Aane do dates, hum milke har din plan karenge. Tum akele nahi ho, thik hai?
